cues: We ratified the Cartagena Protocol in two thousand and one and adopted a biosafety framework in two thousand and six.
In two thousand and fourteen the Supreme Court stopped the import of G M seed.
No G M crop is registered for growing in Nepal, and border samples are checked by P C R.
text: And in Nepal? We ratified the Cartagena Protocol in two thousand and one and adopted a biosafety framework in two thousand and six. In two thousand and fourteen the Supreme Court stopped the import of G M seed. No G M crop is registered for growing in Nepal, and border samples are checked by P C R.
